Passphrase given but not 12 to 1024 characters

operations.summary_zh: 读取一次代理运行及其脱敏日志

operations.summary: Replace schedule, retention and off-host targets
operations.summary_zh: 替换备份计划、保留策略与异地目标
operations.description: expected_revision must equal settings.revision of the status read (409 control_backup_revision_conflict otherwise). Each target names the saved target it edits in stored_name (absent for a new target, which never inherits stored secrets). Empty secret fields keep the stored value of stored_name; for SFTP only while auth stays the same: a changed auth without a matching new credential is 400 control_backup_auth_changed, and a credential that does not fit auth is 400 control_backup_invalid_private_key / control_backup_invalid_password, with error.details {target, field}.

responses.description: Invalid settings or a refused target credential

operations.summary: Write, read back and delete a probe object on the target as on screen (nothing is saved)
operations.summary_zh: 按页面填写的目标写入、回读并删除一个探测对象（不保存任何设置）
operations.description: Body {expected_revision, target}. target is merged over the stored settings exactly as a save would (same stored_name and credential rules), then probed.
